AI agents MUST NOT be listed as authors or co-authors of git commits.
Do NOT use `Co-authored-by:` trailers for AI agents
Do NOT add AI agents to commit author fields
The human developer who reviews and commits the code is the sole author
This is a FINOS-wide policy that applies to all projects under the FINOS umbrella. FINOS requires all contributors to have a signed Contributor License Agreement (CLA) on file. AI agents cannot sign CLAs.

morphir-scala provides Scala bindings and JVM tooling for Morphir. Scala 3.7.4; Mill 1.1.x; ZIO; ScalaJS; Scala Native (experimental).

Layout: `build.mill`; `mill-build/src/` (`millbuild/`); `morphir/` with `src/`, `jvm/src/`, `js/src/`, `contrib/`, `interop/`, `runtime/`, `testing/`, `tools/`; `.config/mise/`; `project/`.

Use mise:
mise run setup
mise run lint
mise run fmt
mise run test:jvm
mise run test:js
mise run ci:local

Or Mill:
./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.compile
./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.test
./mill mill.scalalib.scalafmt.ScalafmtModule/reformatAll 'morphir.__.sources'

For modules under `morphir/foo/`: `src/` shared; `jvm/src/` JVM; `js/src/` JS; `src-3/` Scala 3.x; `jvm/src-3.7/` JVM + Scala 3.7.x. scalafmt 3.10.4, Scala 3 dialect, 120 columns. Run `mise run fmt` before committing. Prefer `given`/`using`, `enum` where appropriate, `derives`, extension methods, `*` imports, `mvn""` (not deprecated `ivy""`), and ZIO libraries. Tests use ZIO Test, `ZIOSpecDefault`, and `test/src/`. Run `mise run test:jvm` or `./mill morphir[3.7.4].__.jvm.test`.

Add modules in `build.mill`; follow cross-platform layout; update `platformSpecificModuleDeps` and parent dependencies as needed. Check Scala 3.7.4 compatibility, source placement, deprecated Mill 1.x syntax; run `mise run lint`.

For deterministic builds:
./mill --no-server -j 1
./mill resolve __
./mill show <target>.sources

CI: GitHub Actions checks lint, test-jvm (Java 21, 25), test-js; publish to Sonatype on main/tags. Runs on PRs, pushes to main/0.4.x, releases, and manual triggers.

Work is NOT complete until all CI checks pass on the Pull Request.
Use `gh pr checks <pr-number> --watch --interval 30` to monitor build status.
If a check fails, investigate immediately. Do not mark task as done.
Check for comments using `gh pr view <pr-number> --json comments,reviews`.
Resolve all comments (code fixes,
